SLOT bluetoothQuickToggle
    INSERT {
        ~&10845406345867313529&~ {
            ~&5972374&~: btQuickToggle
            ~&8399601734642709923&~: "qrc:/ark/icons/bluetooth"
            ~&233726547792244&~: ~&6504329801&~
            ~&7713561545874130&~: btq.powered

            CommandExecutor {
                ~&5972374&~: btExec
            }

            ~&7712130752583461&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: btq
                property ~&6503679477&~ powered: ~&214625660372&~
                property ~&6503679477&~ busy: ~&214625660372&~
                property ~&197102514&~ pairedDevices: []

                ~{btControl}~

                function refreshPaired() {
                    pairedDevices = parseDeviceLines(exec("bluetoothctl devices Paired 2>/dev/null").stdout);
                }

                function refresh() {
                    ~&197102514&~ driverLoaded = ~&7713428776113935&~(exec("lsmod | grep -c btnxpuart || echo 0").stdout.~&6504329413&~()) > 0;
                    powered = driverLoaded && (exec("bluetoothctl show 2>/dev/null | grep 'Powered:'").stdout.~&233731717342038&~(~&"197105914&~) !== -1);
                }

                function findNavigator() {
                    ~&197102514&~ ~&180985&~ = btQuickToggle.~&7083038346995&~;
                    ~&214646069090&~ (~&180985&~) {
                        ~&5972376&~ (~&180985&~.~&2766288418351025740&~) {
                            ~&7083121450889&~ ~&180985&~.~&2766288418351025740&~;
                        }
                        ~&180985&~ = ~&180985&~.~&7083038346995&~;
                    }
                    ~&7083121450889&~ ~&6504117156&~;
                }

                function enable() {
                    powered = ~&6504329801&~;
                    busy = ~&6504329801&~;
                    exec("modprobe btnxpuart 2>/dev/null; true");
                    exec("chmod 755 /etc/bluetooth 2>/dev/null; true");
                    exec("sed -i 's/^#UserspaceHID=true/UserspaceHID=true/' /etc/bluetooth/input.conf 2>/dev/null; true");
                    btqEnablePoll.ticks = 0;
                    btqEnablePoll.~&233743626668842&~ = ~&6504329801&~;
                }

                function disable() {
                    btqEnablePoll.~&233743626668842&~ = ~&214625660372&~;
                    busy = ~&214625660372&~;
                    powered = ~&214625660372&~;
                    exec("bluetoothctl power off 2>/dev/null; true");
                    exec("rmmod btnxpuart 2>/dev/null; true");
                    clearUdevRules();
                    refresh();
                }
            }

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: btqEnablePoll
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 1000
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&6504329801&~
                property ~&197088788&~ ticks: 0
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ticks++;
                    ~&197102514&~ pwr = btq.exec("bluetoothctl show 2>/dev/null | grep 'Powered:'").stdout;
                    ~&5972376&~ (pwr.~&233731717342038&~(~&"197105914&~) !== -1) {
                        ~&233743626668842&~ = ~&214625660372&~;
                        btq.busy = ~&214625660372&~;
                        btq.refreshPaired();
                        btq.writeUdevRules();
                        btq.refresh();
                        ~&7083121450889&~;
                    }
                    btq.exec("bluetoothctl power on 2>/dev/null; true");
                    btq.exec("bluetoothctl pairable on 2>/dev/null; true");
                    ~&5972376&~ (ticks >= 10) {
                        ~&233743626668842&~ = ~&214625660372&~;
                        btq.busy = ~&214625660372&~;
                        btq.exec("rmmod btnxpuart 2>/dev/null; true");
                        btq.refresh();
                    }
                }
            }

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: btqStatePoll
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 3000
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&6504329801&~
                ~&233743626668842&~: btQuickToggle.~&233748328658231&~ && !btq.busy
                ~&495358363329399331&~: btq.refresh()
            }

            ~&254480451320573660&~.~&495334332051582499&~: btq.refresh()

            ~&254542236275632405&~: {
                ~&5972376&~ (btq.busy) {
                    ~&7083121450889&~;
                }
                ~&5972376&~ (btq.powered) {
                    btq.disable();
                } ~&6503784146&~ {
                    btq.enable();
                }
            }

            ~&383135108587212173&~: {
                ~&197102514&~ nav = btq.findNavigator();
                ~&5972376&~ (nav) {
                    nav.~&6504147419&~(~&"16962669231808009333&~, { ~&7082453764199&~: "showBluetoothSettings" });
                    nav.~&214622501183&~(~&"13710581283192580798&~);
                }
            }
        }
    }
END SLOT
